|lore=“He doesn’t want you at all, he’s after somebody called, uh... Skywalker.” “Luke?” “Lord Vader has set a trap for him.” “And we’re the bait!” “Yeah, well, he’s on his way.”
|game_text=Deploy on table. While Vader present at a Cloud City battleground site, your Force drain and Force drain bonuses at that site may not be canceled. Once per game, you may use 1 Force to ▲ one Effect with “Bespin" or "Cloud City" in the game text. Place this Effect in Used Pile if Luke, Leia, Han, or Chewie wins a battle on Cloud City. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The January and October slips differ in quotation marks. The remaster replaces the protected drain with a prohibition on It’s A Trap!, deploys the eligible Effect instead of taking it into hand, includes lore in the search and drops Alter immunity. A listed character winning a Cloud City battle still sends the Effect to the Used Pile.
